nodes.label: Round launcher icon (xxhdpi) for the Minima Core node app (org.minimarex.minimacore): the stock Android Studio adaptive-icon template — a white Android robot head (two antennae, two green eyes) on a green grid background with a diagonal long shadow, clipped to a circle. It is NOT custom Minima branding; the app still ships the default template artwork, so the launcher identity carries Android platform branding rather than Minima's.
